chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was brought very hot food, so he said: 'It was not fitting for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to feed us with fire. Let it cool down until it is manageable, for it is food devoid of blessing, and for Satan there is a share in it.'

key_terms.وَلِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ نَصِيبٌ: and for Satan there is a share in it

ai.seo_question: Why is hot food considered to have less blessing and a share for Satan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the spiritual and physical wisdom behind allowing hot food to cool, linking the physical sensation of heat to the metaphysical presence of Satan. He characterizes hastily consumed hot food as 'makhquq al-barakah' (deprived of blessing), suggesting that the rush to eat distracts from mindfulness (tadabbur) and invites the devil's influence. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating physical health with spiritual awareness in daily acts of worship like eating.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that they came to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> with very hot food. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘It was not for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic to Feed us the fire. Allow it to cool down to enable (it to be eaten), for it (hot food) is a food with devoid of Blessings, and for the Satan<sup>la</sup> there is a share in it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

once very hot food was brought to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, who said, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, is not to feed us fire. Leave it until it becomes cold and possible to eat it. Hot food is without blessing and Satan has a share in it.’”
